_doc: 선물의 숲 UI 시안 작업표. 화면 기획은 docs/ui/SCREEN_PLAN_v1.md (4장 S1 마을, S3 거래 / 6장 방향 A·B·C). 세 방향 모두 배치는 같고 틀의 재질만 다르다. 결과는 방향을 고르기 위한 시안이며 게임에 넣는 그림이 아니다. 그림 속 한글·숫자는 틀릴 수 있으니 재질·배치·분위기만 본다. ref: 주인공 기준 C3, 주인공 평소 자세, 건물 기준(오소리 대부).

directions.A: 통나무 간판 + 나뭇잎 종이 — 마을의 사물로 만든 UI (기본안)
directions.B: 말랑 잎사귀 버블 — 흰 테두리의 둥근 파스텔 버블, 가볍고 간소
directions.C: 장부와 도장 스크랩북 — 크림 종이 스티커, 줄 쳐진 장부, 붉은 도장

jobs.prompt: A mobile game screenshot, portrait phone screen 9:16, full screen, flat 2D casual cozy game UI, shown straight-on with no phone frame, no hands, no perspective. It is the village screen of a cozy idle clicker game about a cute chipmunk who is in debt. The whole screen is ONE continuous hand-painted forest village landscape (not a grid, not cards, no boxes around buildings): pale sky at the top with two soft clouds, a band of distant rounded tree silhouettes, a grassy clearing, and a winding packed-dirt path that zig-zags from the back to the front and connects every building. Layout from top to bottom, follow it exactly. (1) HUD floating over the sky, no background bar: three cream pill-shaped counters with dark-brown outlines; left pill is the biggest with an acorn coin icon overlapping its left edge and the number 100,000; middle pill has a small folded-leaf ledger icon and the text 빚 300,000; right pill has a small bell icon and the text 42초. (2) Far row, slightly smaller and slightly paler, three forest buildings standing on the grass side by side but staggered, not aligned in a straight line: a stern tree-stump bank with grey stone columns, a shiny honey-yellow round stump shop with an oversized blank yellow signboard, and a big wooden scoreboard between two log posts with a bell. (3) Middle row, three buildings: a small mossy stone archive office on the left, a patched old canvas tent under a big tree in the centre (the player's home, slightly larger, with a bark mailbox), and a little alley of five tiny different forest houses with different coloured doors on the right. (4) Near row: on the left a shabby leaning two-storey log office with an outside staircase exactly like the building reference image, with a small tilted red paper tag stuck on its roof; on the right a dark gap between huge tree roots. Under each building is a tiny wooden plank name tag hanging from a twig, with one or two tiny Korean words. (5) Foreground at the bottom centre, large and clearly the star of the screen: the chipmunk from the character reference, about one sixth of the screen height, bending down to pick up an acorn on a patch of bare dirt scattered with acorns; one acorn is bouncing up, and a floating cream-outlined number +60 rises above its head. Beside it a small burlap sack half full of acorns, and a short wooden signpost. (6) Bottom tab bar: two big chunky wooden plank tabs side by side with visible thickness on the bottom edge; the left one is raised and brighter, with a small leaf-roof house icon and the word 마을; the right one has a small chart-on-a-plank icon and the word 거래. UI material for this direction: carved wooden log planks with a light top highlight and a dark bottom edge that gives physical depth, rope and twig hangers, cream leaf-paper labels with a faint vein. Every UI piece looks like an object made in this forest village. Art style: cute pastel soft cel shading, smooth colour blocks, soft two-tone shadows, no black outlines (edges are a darker tone of the fill colour), warm muted sage greens and browns, the orange chipmunk is the brightest thing on screen. Cozy storybook forest village; no modern objects, no cars, no screens, no neon. Text: keep text minimal, only the short Korean words and numbers named above; no other text, no English words, no watermarks, no real brand names or logos.

A mobile game screenshot, portrait phone screen 9:16, full screen, flat 2D casual cozy game UI, shown straight-on with no phone frame, no hands, no perspective. It is the trading screen of a cozy game about a cute chipmunk who trades acorn futures from a tree-stump desk in a forest village. Everything fits on this one screen; no popups, no overlapping windows. Background: the warm wooden top of a stump desk inside a cozy forest home, with a few leaves at the edges. Layout from top to bottom, follow it exactly. (1) HUD: three cream pill-shaped counters with dark-brown outlines; left and biggest has an acorn coin icon and 100,000; middle has a folded-leaf ledger icon and 빚 300,000; right has a bell icon and 42초. (2) A row of five small wooden price tags hanging from a string, each with a tiny Korean name and a tiny up or down triangle with a percent; the first tag hangs lower and is brighter (selected). (3) A price line: a big number 67,929 with a small down triangle on the left. (4) The main chart board, about one quarter of the screen height: a thick carved log frame around a cream leaf-paper sheet with faint horizontal guide lines; one smooth thick price line with a soft fill under it and a round dot at the latest point; one solid horizontal line for the entry price, one red dashed horizontal line near the bottom for the liquidation price, and two thin dotted lines for stop-loss and take-profit, each with a tiny tag at the right edge. In the bottom-left corner of the chart board, peeking over the frame, the head and paws of the chipmunk from the character reference, eyes sparkling and excited, looking up at the line. (5) A wooden plank result sign under the chart: small text 롱 25배 on the left and a very large number +12.4% in the centre. (6) A leverage ruler: a horizontal wooden ruler with eight notches labelled 1 2 5 10 25 50 100 200, an acorn-shaped knob sitting on the 25 notch, the last two notches painted red, and small round minus and plus buttons at both ends. (7) A row of four acorn-cap shaped chips labelled 10% 25% 50% 전부, the second one pressed in and dark. (8) A row with two small steppers, each with left and right arrow buttons: 손절 −25% and 익절 +50%. (9) Two very large chunky buttons side by side with thick bottom edges like physical blocks: the left one coral red with a big up triangle and the word 롱, the right one soft blue with a big down triangle and the word 숏. (10) Bottom tab bar: two big wooden plank tabs with thickness; left has a small leaf-roof house icon and 마을; right is raised and brighter with a small chart icon and 거래. UI material for this direction: carved wooden log planks with a light top highlight and a dark bottom edge for depth, rope and string, cream leaf-paper sheets. Every control looks like a handmade forest object, and the buttons look pressable. Art style: cute pastel soft cel shading, smooth colour blocks, soft two-tone shadows, no black outlines, warm muted browns, sage greens and cream. No real stock or crypto tickers, no real brand names or logos. Text: keep text minimal, only the short Korean words and numbers named above; no other text, no English words, no watermarks.
